To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) we derive a novel indicator to characterize the efficiency for escaping from minima; 2) we show that the anistropic noise in SGD satisfies this indicator and hence helps escaping from sharp minima effectively, and thus helps generalization; 3) we show that anisotropic noise can also be viewed as a regularization effect, which can be used to regularize the learning rate in the training of deep learning models.
the anisotropy in the noise of stochastic gradient descent (SDG) is beneficial for escaping from sharp minima and for regularization.
the anisotropy of the noise in SGD is beneficial for escaping from poor and sharp local minima.
